passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: This is my bicycle, and it has two wheels.
phrases.ko: 이것은 나의 자전거이고, 바퀴가 두 개 있어요.

phrases.en: I wear a helmet, and I ride to the park.
phrases.ko: 나는 헬멧을 쓰고, 공원까지 자전거를 타요.

phrases.en: I do not ride too fast, and I stay safe.
phrases.ko: 나는 너무 빨리 타지 않고, 안전하게 타요.

phrases.en: The bell rings when people are near.
A helmet keeps my head safe.
phrases.ko: 헬멧은 내 머리를 안전하게 해 줘요.

phrases.en: I ride with my brother on Saturday.
We stop at the park and rest.
Fast is not safe, so I ride slowly there.
phrases.ko: 빠른 것은 안전하지 않아서 나는 거기서 천천히 타요.

phrases.en: My bicycle is fun, and I take care of it.
phrases.ko: 나의 자전거는 재미있고, 나는 자전거를 소중히 다뤄요.

full_passage_spoken: This is my bicycle, and it has two wheels. It has a bell. I wear a helmet, and I ride to the park. I do not ride too fast, and I stay safe. It is fun. The bell rings when people are near. A helmet keeps my head safe. I ride with my brother on Saturday. We stop at the park and rest. Fast is not safe, so I ride slowly there. My bicycle is fun, and I take care of it.
